advancedtechnologyservices-advancedtechn.title: Maintenance Technician II
advancedtechnologyservices-advancedtechn.description: Founded in 1985, ATS is a company with a presence in the United States, Mexico and the United Kingdom. We are professionals in Industrial Maintenance and we make factories run better. Fundada en 1985, ATS es una empresa con presencia en los Estados Unidos, México y el Reino Unido. Somos profesionales en mantenimiento industrial y hacemos que las fábricas funcionen mejor. Principal Duties/Responsibilities: · Performs mid- to expert-level break-fix & preventative maintenance. This includes but is not limited to: observing devises in operation to location root cause of problem; dismantling devices to gain access to and remove defective parts; examining parts to detect imperfections; adjustment of functional parts of devices and control instruments; repair and/or replacement of defective parts; testing of device to observe performance; and performing tests for electrical circuitry and mechanical systems; reconditioning and repairing machine tools. · Identifies and sources parts, supplies, and repair items as necessary. · Independently performs maintenance as per industry standards. · May be required to set up and operate multiple machining operations including but not limited to: lathe, drill press, grinder, and other metalworking tools to make and repair parts. May perform welding tasks. · Complies with 5S and housekeeping standards. · Drives and participates in CI activities - processes, results, and cost savings. · Updates records and reviews CMMS history. · Troubleshoots and analyzes control systems to resolve software/ hardware and configuration problems. · Utilizes predictive maintenance technologies to collect equipment performance data. · Provides assistance to lower-level technicians and leadership to small teams. Performs more advanced functions as a part of training and development. · Completes on-the-job and technical self-study programs for career development. · Follows all safety-related policies, rules, regulations, technical instructions, and guidelines. Situational awareness and identifies unsafe behaviors and conditions. Knowledge, Skills, Abilities, & Behaviors Required: · High School Graduate or equivalent (GED). · Associate's degree with a Technical focus and 3 years of related experience in general industry; or 5 years of related experience in general industry or successful completion of the ATS Technician Progression Program. · Understands electrical, mechanical, fluid power, and control systems. Can analyze problems and perform repairs. · Must be able to use basic hand tools and specialized tools as appropriate · May be required to travel. Physical Demands and Working Conditions: While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to stand; walk; use hands/fingers to handle or feel; reach with hands and arms; climb, ascend/descend, or balance to heights that may require a ladder or lift; stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl in confined spaces; and talk or hear. The employee is occasionally required to sit. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move more than 50 pounds. The employee is regularly required to use close vision and color vision. The employee is occasionally exposed to outside weather conditions and risk of electrical shock. Work is typically performed in a factory environment and is usually very loud. In the factory environment, the employee may be exposed to hazardous materials and/or greasy or slippery factory floors. ATS believes in fair and equitable pay. Please note that actual salaries may vary within the range, or be above or below the range, based on factors including, but not limited to, education, training, experience, professional achievement, business need, and location. We also offer market-leading benefit programs, including Medical, Dental, and Vision plans, PTO, 401 (k) retirement plans with employer matching, tuition reimbursement, and more. Pay Range $28.82—$36.85 USD ATS is committed to providing equal employment opportunities in all aspects of employmen

aegworldwide-aegworldwide:greenhouse:864.description: Company Information For more than 20 years, AEG has played a pivotal role in transforming sports and live entertainment. Annually, we host more than 160 million guests, promote more than 10,000 shows and present more than 22,000 events around the world. We are committed to innovation, artistry, and community, and leverage the power of our 300+ venues, leading sports franchises, marquee music brands, integrated entertainment districts, premier ticketing platform and global sponsorship activations, to create memorable moments that give the world reason to cheer. Our business is interwoven with the human mind and heart, and we strive to build a diverse and inclusive company that reflects the artists, athletes, and fans that we host; reach beyond traditional boundaries to support the communities in which we operate; and minimize our impact on the environment by adopting sustainable practices throughout our business operations. If you want to be challenged to up your game and make a difference, then join us in giving the world reason to cheer! Job Summary The Manager, Ticket Sales is responsible for leading the LA Galaxy's season ticket sales team, with a focus on driving new revenue and enhancing client satisfaction. This role oversees daily operations, recruits and develops sales staff, and implements strategic initiatives for full-season, partial-plan, and individual ticket sales. Additional responsibilities include cross-selling and upselling, managing account touchpoints, improving operational efficiencies, overseeing debt collection, and collaborating with leadership to align sales goals through business analysis and strategic planning. cic-cic:lever:7161875b-c4d0-4751-a37d-e3.title: Program & Experience Design Coordinator, Venture Café London
cic-cic:lever:7161875b-c4d0-4751-a37d-e3.description: Are you ready to be at the heart of London's innovation scene? Venture Café London is on the lookout for a passionate Program and Experience Design Coordinator to support our flagship Thursday Gathering and other groundbreaking initiatives. Join us in creating a dynamic and inclusive community where innovators connect, collaborate, and drive change. If you're excited about making a real impact and fostering a vibrant ecosystem, you belong at Venture Café London! ABOUT VENTURE CAFÉ GLOBAL INSTITUTE (VCGI) & VENTURE CAFÉ LONDON Venture Café Global Institute (VCGI) began in 2009 within the Cambridge Innovation Center (CIC) in Massachusetts, aiming to connect people, ideas, and resources globally. Today, it has grown into a worldwide movement, facilitating over 750,000 connections among innovators, creatives, and leaders across cities like Boston, Berlin, and Tokyo. VCGI's mission is to drive global change by building a community of communities focused on solving humankind’s biggest challenges. Venture Café London launched in May 2025 as an activation partner of ARIA. Our mission is to connect innovators to make things happen, convening all parts of the UK science and entrepreneurship network to create the conditions for ambitious ideas to move from early-stage research into real-world capabilities and companies. Since launching, we’re proud to have delivered 55 innovation gatherings for 9000 attendees, showcasing 250 businesses and achieving an NPS of 70 as we build a thriving community of regular attendees. YOUR DAY-TO-DAY WORK We are looking for a curious self-starter to join our team to coordinate an impactful program of events for a community of innovators at the Venture Café’s flagship weekly event: the Thursday Gathering. Your role would be to execute weekly Venture Café Thursday Gatherings including the following: • Coordinating programs and speakers before, during, and after the event. • Setting up and breaking down Thursday Gathering events, including managing program partner bump-ins and outs and setting up the Venture Café Kiosk. • Coordinating local Venture Café Ambassadors to assist at the Thursday Gatherings. • Connecting with the Venture Café Global Institute to share learnings and support the relationship between Venture Café London and its global counterparts. • Identifying and mitigating risks to the effective operation of the Thursday Gathering. • Collaborating with the ARIA team and our weekly ecosystem partners to ensure a delightful event experience. • Curating relevant, engaging workshops for our attendees each week. • Great hospitality skills – able to keep community members engaged and happy even while resolving problems. Be able to enforce the Venture Café credo/guidelines in a friendly but firm fashion. ABOUT YOU With a background in event management or innovation ecosystems, you bring creativity and flexibility to Venture Café London, driven by a passion for mission-driven work and a commitment to hosting successful events. Your customer service excellence, problem-solving skills, and openness to learning from failure, paired with meticulous attention to detail, prepare you for success in this role. You excel in executing and innovating event experiences, engaging diverse community members, creatively using spaces, communicating effectively in various settings, and solving problems in fast-paced environments. Additionally, you have: • Ideally at least 1-3 years of professional events experience. • English fluency. • Familiarity with social media channels and ability to leverage them as part of your work. • Willingness for domestic and international travel as needed. • Ability to legally work in the UK. We are unable to sponsor visas for this role at this time. • A STEM background is not required, but an educational background in Biology, Chemistry, or a related scientific field would be considered a bonus. OUR OFFER • Competitive salary, commensurate with experience • 25 days of annual leave, plus bank

jobgether-jobgether:lever:10bea31a-c3c5-.title: Senior Mobile Game UI/UX Artist
jobgether-jobgether:lever:10bea31a-c3c5-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Mobile Game UI/UX Artist based in Belgium. This is a senior creative role focused on shaping intuitive, expressive, and highly engaging interfaces for mobile games enjoyed by players around the world. You will define the visual identity of the game UI while building scalable systems that keep experiences consistent across devices and screen sizes. The role combines visual design, UX thinking, prototyping, design systems, and close collaboration with game development teams. You will transform concepts into polished interfaces, seamlessly blending 2D UI with 3D game assets while maintaining strong hierarchy and visual impact. You will also contribute to modern AI-assisted workflows that accelerate ideation, exploration, and asset creation. Success requires both artistic excellence and a systems mindset, with a strong understanding of mobile gaming conventions and player behavior. This is an opportunity to make a visible impact in a fast-moving, remote-friendly environment where creativity, experimentation, and collaboration are highly valued. Define and own the visual direction, layout, interaction patterns, and overall artistic quality of mobile game interfaces. Create high-fidelity 2D UI assets, icons, screens, menus, and interactive elements that are colorful, polished, intuitive, and optimized for mobile devices. Integrate 2D UI layers with 3D game assets while maintaining visual hierarchy, depth, readability, and a cohesive aesthetic. Build, scale, and maintain a component-driven UI design system in Figma, including reusable components, variants, variables, auto-layout structures, and responsive behaviors. Design modular and reusable UI components that account for mobile platform constraints and different screen sizes and aspect ratios. Create user flows, wireframes, mockups, interactive prototypes, and iconography that prioritize intuitive navigation, touch ergonomics, and engaging player interactions. Design interfaces for modern free-to-play meta systems, including progression tracks, Battle Passes, collection systems, rewards, and other engagement features. Collaborate closely with programmers, technical artists, producers, and other creative stakeholders to ensure designs are implemented accurately and retain their intended visual quality in-engine. Use generative AI and AI-assisted design tools to accelerate brainstorming, mood-board development, concept exploration, iteration, and asset generation. Maintain clear design documentation and communicate UI logic and design-system principles effectively to technical and creative teams. Contribute to UI animations, visual effects, and other implementation considerations where appropriate. Continuously refine the player experience by balancing visual excitement with clarity, usability, consistency, and performance. Requirements 10+ years of professional game-art experience, including at least 5 years specializing in UI/UX art. A strong portfolio demonstrating exceptional mobile game UI/UX work, including visual case studies or references from at least 2 shipped mobile titles. Excellent understanding of composition, color theory, typography, layout, visual hierarchy, and stylized 2D game-art production. Deep knowledge of mobile game UI principles, including touch interfaces, gesture controls, ergonomics, and iOS/Android design considerations. Strong understanding of free-to-play game meta systems such as Battle Passes, progression tracks, collection systems, and reward loops. Expert-level proficiency with Figma, including auto-layout, nested components, variables, variants, design systems, and interactive prototyping. Strong proficiency with Adobe Photoshop and Illustrator for high-fidelity asset creation, iconography, vectors, textures, and visual treatments. Proven experience creating and managing comprehensive UI design systems and style

pearvc-pear-vc:ashbyhq:346da483-cdcd-438.title: Founding Software Engineer - Optexity (India)
pearvc-pear-vc:ashbyhq:346da483-cdcd-438.description: ABOUT OPTEXITY Optexity is a product-driven research lab building clinical reasoning and computer use models for hospitals and clinics. We are building world class search and chat system for doctors to help them find information quickly and elevate the level of care. We deploy directly inside clinics and hospitals — including systems with no APIs, using integration infrastructure we've built and open-sourced — and in return become their preferred partner. That gives us proprietary clinical reasoning trajectories from practicing physicians, and a feedback loop between real patient encounters, our models, and the products built on top of them. We're a small, fast-moving founding team with multiple published papers in NeurIPS, ICML, CVPR etc and background from Apple, Amazon, Microsoft, CMU, IIT. We are backed by world-class investors and leaders like Jeff Dean, Neotribe VC, PearVC, Together Fund and Zapier Fund. HOW WE WORK - Customer obsession — we start with the customer and work backwards - Intellectual honesty — ideas matter more than titles; we communicate directly and assume good intent, even in disagreement - Bias for action — we build and learn with customers rather than debate in the abstract - Extreme ownership — we own outcomes, not just tasks, and see problems through What you'll do - Work on large scale search systems on real, proprietary clinical data from hospital and clinic partners to surface insights for doctors to help with clinical reasoning. - Build semantic search system on large unstructured data. - Work on customer facing products and be part of fast moving team. - Own the product design end to end. - Take open-ended problems from question to working model, with minimal predefined structure - Write up findings as technical reports and papers Ideal candidate - Has real minimum two years of experience in deploying production systems. - Bachelor's in computer science and related fields. - Energized by open-ended problems and ambiguity - Takes ownership without needing to be guided - Genuinely wants a startup over big tech — speed and ambiguity as defaults, not exceptions Nice to have - Prior founder or founding-engineer experience - Strong product taste - Built LLM-powered products before - Ambitions to start your own company someday — we'll support that path What you get - Direct, daily work with the founders, plus exposure to board and investor conversations - Real ownership of technical direction, with scope that grows as the company does - Full compute and data to do the work properly - Competitive salary and meaningful equity

redesignhealth-redesign-health:ashbyhq:5.title: Director of Technology, New Ventures — Cedars-Sinai Digital Innovation Platform
redesignhealth-redesign-health:ashbyhq:5.description: ABOUT THE COMPANY Redesign Health is a global venture and applied technology firm focused on building next-generation healthcare companies. We manage venture capital and venture buyout strategies, each powered by an AI operating system and a team of leading technologists, entrepreneurs, and investors. Since inception in 2018, Redesign and our portfolio companies have touched the lives of more than 15 million patients, raised over $1.5 billion from premier institutional, sovereign, and strategic investors, and built distinctive partnerships with marquee healthcare organizations around the world. Redesign is based in New York with offices in Bengaluru, Los Angeles, and Riyadh. Like the startups we build, we embed AI deeply into all our operations — freeing our team to focus their creativity and technical judgment on the highest-impact problems. We seek curious, adaptable builders who are eager to experiment constantly and push the boundaries of what’s possible at the intersection of human ingenuity and artificial intelligence. ABOUT THE PARTNERSHIP Redesign Health and Cedars-Sinai have launched a Digital Innovation Platform https://www.cedars-sinai.org/newsroom/cedars-sinai-launches-digital-innovation-hub-to-advance-healthcare-solutions/, a first-of-its-kind venture creation engine embedded inside one of the world’s premier academic medical centers. The platform pairs Redesign’s healthcare company-building methodology with something no standalone venture firm can offer: Cedars-Sinai’s 4,500+ physicians and nurses, an expansive clinical network of 40+ hospitals and sites of care, a purpose-built synthetic and de-identified data platform, and a standing commitment to serve as the first customer for every company the platform creates. Ideas originate from the clinicians and researchers who see problems up close every day; the companies that emerge are validated in real clinical environments before they ever reach the broader market. Initial focus areas include personalized medicine, specialty care access, hospital workflow optimization, clinical decision support, and care coordination. ABOUT THE ROLE We’re looking for a technical builder who has done it before and knows what it takes to take an idea from -1 to 0 and turn it into a real product and a real company. As Director of Technology, you are the technical engine of the Redesign–Cedars-Sinai partnership. Working alongside the VP of Technology, AI Ventures and the New Ventures team, you’ll embed inside Cedars-Sinai’s clinical ecosystem to find the problems worth building companies around, judge whether the technology to solve them actually works, and help diligence and then support exceptional founders to turn validated clinical theses into enduring companies. You bring the product and engineering conviction; Cedars brings the clinical truth and the first customer. WHAT YOU’LL DO Evaluate opportunities and technology with Cedars-Sinai. weloglobal-weloglobal:lever:e461c019-5e8.description: Role Overview We’re hiring data collection operators to support physical AI programs. In this role, you’ll operate physical AI data collection systems (via teleoperation tools or guided interfaces) to generate high-quality real-world data used to train and evaluate AI models. This is hands-on, execution-focused work. You’ll be working with real hardware in structured environments, following defined scenarios, and helping produce the data that directly shapes how physical AI devices learn and perform. Project Details Location: 100% Onsite (Santa Clara, CA) Employment: Full time W-2, 5 days/week Morning Shift: 7:00 AM to 3:30 PM | $35/hour Night Shift: 3:30 PM to 12:00 AM | $38.50/hour Physical Commitment: Must be able to stand for several hours and carry up to 75 lbs. Start Date: ASAP Why This Role Matters The data generated in this role directly impacts how physical AI systems learn to operate in the real world. Strong execution here leads to better, safer, and more reliable autonomous systems.
